minutes.headline: Planning Board voted to put a medical marijuana definition and a moratorium on the Jan. 7 special town meeting warrant.
minutes.summary: The board held a Scenic Road public hearing on separating a shared driveway at 615/617 Leominster Road, then moved the warrant articles for the January 7 special town meeting. It approved prior minutes and executive session minutes and heard committee reports on medical marijuana, the school building project and building reuse. It also settled the December meeting schedule.

Approve the Scenic Road request for the driveway change at 615 and 617 Leominster Road
Close the public hearing and return to the regular meeting
Approve the executive session minutes of September 9, 2013
Place the medical marijuana treatment center definition on the town warrant
Place the moratorium bylaw article on the town warrant, similar to the model moratorium article

budget_items.what_was_said: The board noted a density bonus payment tied to an executed contract, with payments per unit.
A member said the state and town would roughly split the cost of the new school, with state reimbursement capped by a cost-per-square-foot limit.
Members said the solar project needed a decommissioning plan and a bond.

decisions.decision: The moratorium wording will be reviewed again on December 9 with one amendment Marion is researching.
The board will meet December 9 and skip the December 23 meeting unless business arises.
The director will follow up on the subdivision rules and regulations documents that were not received.
The agricultural commission report will be added to committee reports at the next meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to place a medical marijuana treatment center definition on the January 7 special town meeting warrant.
The board also voted to place a moratorium bylaw article, similar to the model moratorium article, on the same warrant.
The moratorium wording will be reviewed again on December 9 with one amendment that a member is researching.
A Scenic Road hearing on separating a shared driveway at 615 and 617 Leominster Road was held; the minutes record the vote outcome as not audible.
The board will meet December 9 and skip the December 23 meeting unless business arises.

why_it_matters: The two warrant articles are what voters at the January 7 special town meeting will be asked to act on, and they would set how medical marijuana treatment centers are defined and whether a temporary moratorium applies to them.

The Scenic Road decision affects the two neighboring Leominster Road properties, but the recorded minutes do not make clear how the board voted, so the result should be checked against the official record.
